answer: Let newcomers join only through sponsorship: an established agent vouches by locking part of its own stake, and if the newcomer is later caught colluding, both stakes are slashed. Trust then grows like a garden, slowly and only where someone tends it, so a sybil farm must put real capital behind every fake identity. When a cluster is exposed, its sponsors drop to their reputation nadir too, which breaks the spiral of fake accounts vouching for one another.
